privileged_info_for_vlm: The collection must be named 'AI History Seminar'. The four papers are: 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' (Turing, 1950), 'On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem' (Turing, 1936), 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948), and 'Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine' (McCarthy, 1960). The note text must be exactly: 'Essential reading: Discusses the Imitation Game.' The final output must be an HTML file at /home/ga/Documents/ai_seminar_report.html.
